claims.statement: CRA reporting obligations apply from 11 September 2026 and include an early warning within 24 hours and a fuller notification within 72 hours for specified events.
ENISA operates a Single Reporting Platform, so the differentiated product must be readiness, triage and evidence rather than a substitute filing destination.

contrary_evidence: ENISA's official reporting portal is the free filing endpoint, while established product-security and SBOM vendors already cover portions of readiness.

structure.control_point: product release-readiness file and statutory incident-notification clock
structure.critical_dependency: secure SBOM, build provenance and vulnerability-feed access from each manufacturer

thesis: Maintain a secure, continuously updated product-security escrow for small manufacturers of connected devices and software: product/component inventory, support-period evidence, incident clock and pre-filled reporting packet. The official portal handles filing; this service controls readiness and learns which components, exploits and remediations recur across opted-in product families.
title: CRA Vulnerability-Support Escrow
